title: finding(app-shell): the declared `@objectstack/spec` range `^17.3.0` lacks four symbols app-shell imports at runtime, so the nightly Spec Range Floors alarm is red on main and the publish-path gate would cancel the next release
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites, class (a). Reader: triage first (route and grade). ⛔ Not graded here.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 4 (`session_01MCg3z5cGrV51xEddpGcxEY`) from the objectui#10842 dev report (`5860704537`, `out_of_scope_findings[2]`), after the seat re-measured it. No open card covers it: open and recently updated issues were listed and grepped for `spec-floors`, `Range Floors`, the four symbol names and the two failing run ids.

## What is wrong

`packages/app-shell/package.json` declares `"@objectstack/spec": "^17.3.0"`. At objectui `origin/main`, two shipped app-shell sources import four spec symbols at runtime:
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/screen-spec.ts`: `import { predicateSlotRefusal } from '@objectstack/spec/automation'`;
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/simulator/flow-sim-validate.ts`: `structuralConditionRefusal` (automation), and `import { EVALUATED_EXPRESSION_SOURCE_REQUIRED, EvaluatedExpressionSchema } from '@objectstack/spec/shared'`.

Measured by this seat: the published `@objectstack/spec@17.3.0` tarball (`npm pack`) contains none of the four names anywhere under `dist/`. So a consumer that installs `@object-ui/app-shell` with spec 17.3.0, which the declared range allows, gets a module that names exports its spec does not have. `@object-ui/types` already declares `^17.4.0`.

## Reach

- **The nightly alarm is red on main.** The `Spec Range Floors` workflow (`.github/workflows/spec-range-floors.yml`, scheduled, objectui#5793) failed on 2026-09-26 (run 36217768665, `9c78ebe3a`) and on 2026-09-27 (run 36294331626, `a2f361b8c`), at step 「Verify every declared spec floor carries the symbols its artifact uses」. It was green on 2026-09-25 (`93fea2ef9`). This seat could not read those job logs: the log download host refused this container. So the CI finding list is not quoted here.
- **The dev's local run** of `pnpm check:spec-floors` at objectui PR objectui#10863's head `7356c90` exited 1 with 4 `floor-too-low` findings in `@object-ui/app-shell` (these four symbols; the PR touches no app-shell file, so the same holds at base `4aebea0`), plus one `no-artifact` for an unbuilt `plugin-tree` (a local build gap, not a finding).
- **The publish path.** Per the workflow header, `pnpm changeset:publish` runs the same gate before any tarball reaches npm, and a floor that lies cancels the release. So the next release is blocked until this is repaired.

## Direction (for triage to confirm)

- Raise app-shell's declared range to the first spec version that exports all four (the gate names `^17.4.0`, the range `@object-ui/types` declares), with a `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/app-shell`, and re-run `pnpm check:spec-floors` over a full build.
- Likely origin, not verified: PR objectui#10672 (merged 2026-09-25, the flow simulator's CEL edge guards, `flow-sim-validate.ts`) fits the green-to-red window. This was read from a shallow clone, so it is not a proven first introduction.

## Re-check

- `git -C objectui show origin/main:packages/app-shell/package.json | grep @objectstack/spec` still answers `^17.3.0`.
- `npm pack @objectstack/spec@17.3.0` then `grep -rl predicateSlotRefusal package/dist` answers nothing.
- The latest `spec-range-floors.yml` scheduled run on main is still `failure`.
